about: Leftover wording from when Cheer Pressure was a typing product or a flat list of measures. scripts/check-wording.mts greps the source for `everywhere`; scripts/check-categories.mts checks `everywhere` and `rendered` in the text of every screen. Matching ignores case. `allow` lists the only places a phrase may stay, and why.
